name: Singapore
blurb: A garden city-state famous for hawker food and futuristic architecture.
cities: Marina Bay & City
Hawker centres, Gardens by the Bay and a glittering skyline.
Sentosa
Resort island with beaches, theme parks and beach clubs.
Chinatown & Little India
Temples, hawker centres and heritage shophouses.
Singapore Botanic Gardens
A tropical garden with a celebrated orchid collection and lawns for picnics.
Kampong Glam
The Sultan Mosque, Haji Lane boutiques and Middle Eastern cafés.
Orchard Road
Singapore's main shopping street of malls and Christmas lights.
Mandai Wildlife Reserve
Singapore Zoo, the Night Safari and Bird Paradise in the rainforest.
Pulau Ubin
Bike around a rustic island of kampong villages and mangroves.
East Coast Park & Katong
Seaside cycling, Peranakan shophouses and laksa in Katong.
Jewel Changi
The airport's indoor rainforest and the world's tallest indoor waterfall.
Jurong Lake Gardens
Lakeside gardens, the Science Centre and the quieter green west.
Gardens by the Bay
The Supertree Grove light show and two giant cooled conservatories, the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest.
Clarke Quay & the Singapore River
Riverside bars, bumboat rides and dinner along the old godowns of the Singapore River.
Civic District & Raffles Hotel
The National Gallery, colonial landmarks, the Padang and a Singapore Sling at Raffles Hotel.
Fort Canning Park
A historic hilltop park with spice gardens, colonial relics and the photogenic tree tunnel.
Tiong Bahru
Art deco housing blocks, an old wet market and some of the city's best cafes and bakeries.
Haw Par Villa
A free, eccentric theme park of Chinese myth, with dioramas of the Ten Courts of Hell.
Southern Islands (St John's & Kusu)
Ferry-reached islands with lagoons, a turtle temple and quiet picnic beaches.
Bukit Timah Nature Reserve
Primary rainforest and steep trails to Singapore's highest hill.
MacRitchie Reservoir & TreeTop Walk
Forest boardwalks and a suspension bridge across the rainforest canopy.
Southern Ridges & Henderson Waves
A 10 km trail of forest walkways and a wave-shaped bridge linking hilltop parks.
Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve
Mangrove boardwalks with monitor lizards, crocodiles and migratory birds.
Coney Island
A rustic island park of casuarina woods and quiet beaches, reached by bridge.
